meta.description:
A custom port of Scheme Size for newer Mindustry builds.

Started as a schematic size increase, now a set of QoL and admin tools: bigger schematics, building helpers, renderer options, AI, keybinds, CLaJ, and an advanced console.

[accent]Client & server:[]
Same jar works as a normal client mod and on a dedicated server. On a vanilla server (without this mod) you still get client QoL. If the server also has the jar, admin tools like fill, items, units, teleport and rules sync over the network - even when you are not the local host. Those actions require admin.

Requires Mindustry v156+. One jar for desktop and mobile (156–159). Vanilla recommended.

Original mod by [accent]xzxADIxzx[]. Port by [accent]Mithra[]. The original author is not involved in this port.

[accent]
 - Schematic size 512
 - Building & renderer tools
 - Admin tools (optional server sync)
 - AI support
 - CLaJ, keybinds, updater
 - Advanced console & rule setter
